dog.description_text:
Meet Lollipop! 🍭
Lollipop is a sweet girl with a gentle heart who is still learning the ropes. As a stray, very little is known about her life before arriving at the shelter, so her history is unfortunately limited.

While Lollipop may be a little lacking in basic manners right now, she is incredibly sweet and affectionate with staff. She is still learning what is expected of her and would benefit from a patient adopter who is willing to help her build confidence and learn some good manners.

With her loving personality and plenty of potential, Lollipop is looking for someone who will give her the time, patience, and guidance she needs to blossom into the wonderful companion she can be.
dog.name: Lollipop
